title: Ballon d'Or Winner Harry Kane Names Virat Kohli Among Stars He Admires
excerpt: Asked whose Ballon d'Or congratulations meant most, the Bayern Munich striker put Kohli in the same breath as David Beckham and Tom Brady.
body:
• Harry Kane, who won the 2026 Ballon d'Or on October 26, named Virat Kohli alongside David Beckham and Tom Brady as sportspeople he admires who messaged him after the win.
  • Kohli's message praised Kane's "resilience, hard work and honesty" across his years at the top of football.
  • Kane won the award with 1,055 points, ahead of Kylian Mbappé on 1,027, after scoring 73 goals in the 2025-26 season.
  • The two first connected publicly in 2016, when Kane praised Kohli's unbeaten 82 against Australia at the T20 World Cup, and met at Lord's in 2019.

Harry Kane has won football's biggest individual prize, but asked which congratulatory messages meant the most, the England captain reached outside football — to cricket. Speaking at a press conference ahead of Bayern Munich's Champions League fixture against Atlético Madrid, Kane named Virat Kohli among the figures whose messages he valued most after winning the Ballon d'Or.

"I don't know about starstruck. But I had a lot of people I look up to message me. People like David Beckham, who was a big idol of mine, Tom Brady, Virat Kohli — a lot of sportspeople I really admire."

— Harry Kane, Bayern Munich and England striker

Kane added that a message from his friend Ed Sheeran had also come in, and that he was grateful for all of them.

Kohli's message

Kohli had congratulated Kane publicly on X after the award, writing: "Harry, my friend, you deserve every bit of this award for your resilience, hard work and honesty with which you've carried yourself through all these years playing football at the top. Really happy for you. God bless you and your family. They must all be very proud of you, as you would be of your own journey. My best wishes always. Congratulations."

https://x.com/hemantbhavsar86/status/2117615558946648413

The award itself

Kane received the 2026 Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium on October 26, becoming the first Englishman to win it since Michael Owen in 2001. He topped the vote with 1,055 points, just 28 ahead of Kylian Mbappé's 1,027, with Lamine Yamal also among the leading contenders. The award capped a 2025-26 season in which Kane scored 73 goals across club and country.

A decade of mutual respect

The connection between the two is not new. In 2016, Kane publicly praised Kohli's unbeaten 82 against Australia at the T20 World Cup, an innings that carried India to an important win. The pair met in person at Lord's during the 2019 Cricket World Cup period, exchanging signed shirts on the outfield.

That Kane listed a cricketer alongside Beckham and Brady says something about Kohli's reach beyond his own sport. A decade on from that first message of praise, the admiration is still running in both directions.
